Hi all, I want to PFI these EIPs for Hegotá https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8081:

[EIP-5920](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5920): PAY opcode
[EIP-7923](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7923): Linear, Page-Based Memory Costing

I realize these are EL EIPs for the EVM, but given August 6 before this call is the deadline to PFI those, I will therefore PFI them here in this ACDC call.

During this call, we can note that I want to PFI those, but we can defer the actual discussion to the next ACDE, with the explicit note that these EIPs are still "supposed" to be PFId. 

(this raises the question or point: Hegotá meta EIP would then thus have the "final list of EIPs in PFI" after ACDE, and after ACDE has merged those EIPs, I believe we should formalize this somewhere, for instance in EIP-7723: Network Upgrade Inclusion Stages, so it is clear for the community as well)

I want to PFI EIP-8359: Beacon Block Reporting Field

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12063

> I realize these are EL EIPs for the EVM, but given August 6 before this call is the deadline to PFI those, I will therefore PFI them here in this ACDC call.

@jochem-brouwer OK to just add to the next ACDE call agenda here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2178, as long as the PR(s) to PFI into EIP-8081 is open before August 6th, it's considered 'before the deadline'
